name: pipaya-extension-memory
description: A main session that remembers you, searches your past conversations and hands work to other sessions, at little token cost.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: One main session to talk to: it keeps a short memory of you and your setup, searches every past conversation, and hands longer work to other sessions. Only that session carries the memory and its tools; other sessions are left as they are.
descriptions.ko: 대화 상대가 되는 메인 세션 하나를 만듭니다. 사용자와 작업 환경을 짧게 기억하고, 모든 과거 대화를 검색하며, 긴 작업은 다른 세션에 맡깁니다. 메모리와 도구는 이 세션에만 들어가고 다른 세션은 그대로 둡니다.

settings.label: Learn from conversations automatically
settings.description: Every few messages, a model reads the new part of the main session's conversation and updates the memory.

settings.label: Messages between reviews
settings.description: How many of your messages the main session needs since the last review before the next one.

settings.label: Model role for reviews
settings.description: A model role from Settings > Models. Map it to a cheap model; without a mapping the default model is used.
